title: Startup founders urge U.S. government not to shut off Chinese open weight AI
titleZh: 初创公司创始人敦促美国政府不要关闭中国开放重量人工智能
author: theanonymousone
relevanceReason: 命中 1 个 AI/科技关键词。

comments.author: capevace
comments.textRawHtml:
I‘m not even sure what the argument for banning Chinese models/open weights even is supposed to be?

1. if it’s to stop hackers doing hacking things with „uncontrollable models“ then, well… they’re already doing something illegal to begin with, why would they care about breaking another law running these models?

2. if it’s to stop foreign actors, then that ban would not apply to them anyway

3. it’s not stopping distillation either, Chinese labs are already banned from using US frontier models and look at how good that is working

I don’t get it. Am I missing something? The only thing a ban would do is protect the American market from further downward price pressure on inference, protecting VC investors in the short term. But thats also an admittance that the American labs can’t compete on merit anymore, and should by itself also limit the viability of the idea that all those VC billions will ever make a return? In any case this would be something benefitting only a very few for a short time (labs + investors).

Someone please enlighten me what the actual argument here is, cause I can’t see it.
comments.textZhHtml:
我什至不确定禁止中国模型/开放重量的论点应该是什么？

1.如果是为了阻止黑客用“不可控模型”进行黑客攻击，那么，好吧……他们一开始就已经在做非法的事情了，为什么他们会关心违反运行这些模型的另一项法律呢？

2. 如果是为了阻止外国演员，那么该禁令无论如何都不适用于他们

3.它也没有停止蒸馏，中国实验室已经被禁止使用美国前沿模型，看看效果如何

我不明白。我错过了什么吗？禁令唯一能做的就是保护美国市场免受推理价格进一步下行的压力，从而在短期内保护风险投资者。但这也承认美国实验室不能再靠实力进行竞争，而且它本身也应该限制所有这些数十亿风险投资将获得回报的想法的可行性吗？无论如何，这只会在短时间内使极少数人（实验室+投资者）受益。

请有人告诉我这里的实际论点是什么，因为我看不到它。

children.author: Matl
children.textRawHtml:
> Someone please enlighten me what the actual argument here is, cause I can’t see it.

> The only thing a ban would do is protect the American market from further downward price pressure on inference, protecting VC investors in the short term. But thats also an admittance that the American labs can’t compete on merit anymore

That's the argument. To be precise the publicly stated argument is that they're attacking American providers by distilling. The real aim is to eliminate competition because otherwise Anthropic and OpenAI are non viable and the US views them as crucial for winning the 'AI race' which they see as putting whoever wins it on top in terms of warfare/economic power etc.
children.textZhHtml:
> 有人请告诉我这里的实际论点是什么，因为我看不到它。

> 禁令唯一能做的就是保护美国市场免受推理价格进一步下行的压力，从而在短期内保护风险投资者。但这也承认美国实验室无法再靠实力进行竞争

这就是论点。准确地说，公开声明的论点是，他们正在通过蒸馏来攻击美国供应商。真正的目标是消除竞争，因为否则 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 是不可行的，美国认为它们对于赢得“人工智能竞赛”至关重要，他们认为无论谁在战争/经济实力等方面获胜，都将处于领先地位。

children.author: capevace
children.textRawHtml:
But isn‘t the whole argument of „winner takes all“ already dead, if china is such a big threat that the US labs need import controls?

Distilling or not, they are clearly close enough to the frontier, that the supposed „free market“ country needs market controls. That may work for US markets. But not the rest of the world.

Idea: petrodollar policy becomes „tokendollar“, enforced by US military dominance. If you force me to pay altman at gunpoint, then maybe ill stop using kimi
children.textZhHtml:
但如果中国是美国实验室需要的巨大威胁，那么“赢家通吃”的整个论点不是已经死了吗？ 进口 控制？

无论是否蒸馏，它们显然已经足够接近前沿，以至于所谓的“自由市场”国家需要市场控制。这可能适用于美国市场。但世界其他地方则不然。

想法：石油美元政策成为“代币美元”，由美国军事主导地位强制执行。如果你强迫我用枪指着奥特曼，那么也许我会停止使用基米

children.author: Aerroon
children.textRawHtml:
He did do the "can't sell GPUs to Poland*" move when he was on his way out though.

Separating countries into "tier 1" and "tier 2" was a pretty bad look, especially when a bunch of European countries that seemed to have good relations with the US ended up in tier 2. Looked suspiciously similar to the iron curtain.

https://www.euractiv.com/news/biden-divides-eu-with-new-ai-c...

* It wasn't that they couldn't sell GPUs at all, but they put caps on the amount.
children.textZhHtml:
不过，当他离开时，他确实做出了“不能向波兰出售 GPU”的举动。

将国家分为“第一梯队”和“第二梯队”看起来相当糟糕，尤其是当一群看似与美国关系良好的欧洲国家最终落入第二梯队时。看起来与铁幕可疑地相似。

https://www.euractiv.com/news/biden-divides-eu-with-new-ai-c...

* 并不是他们根本不能销售 GPU，而是他们对数量设置了上限。

children.author: mythrwy
children.textRawHtml:
That doesn't describe the candidates on offer though.

Look, I just want good rational, wise, humane low touch governance without excessive political ideology nonsense. I'm sick of the wars, sick of the lies, sick of the economic yo yo of boom/bust, sick of progressivism and "woke", sick of religion being injected into the conversation, sick of idiot candidates put there by the wealthy. And no, I'm not going to pretend that Joe Biden administration or Kamala was acceptable. Nor am I going to pretend that socialism is really gonna work this time, it's not and will leave most people worse off over the long term.

I realize this might be too much to ask, for but a boy can dream.
children.textZhHtml:
但这并没有描述所提供的候选人。

你看，我只是想要良好的理性、明智、人道的低接触治理，没有过多的政治意识形态废话。我厌倦了战争，厌倦了谎言，厌倦了经济的繁荣/萧条，厌倦了进步主义和“觉醒”，厌倦了宗教被注入谈话，厌倦了富人放在那里的白痴候选人。不，我不会假装乔·拜登政府或卡马拉是可以接受的。我也不会假装社会主义这次真的会起作用，从长远来看，它不会，而且会让大多数人的境况变得更糟。

我意识到这个要求可能有点过分，但男孩是可以梦想的。

children.author: vrganj
children.textRawHtml:
I already am eating from the trashcan all the time. The name of this trashcan is ideology.

The material force of ideology makes me not see what I am effectively eating. It’s not only our reality which enslaves us. The tragedy of our predicament when we are within ideology is that when we think that we escape it into our dreams, at that point we are within ideology.

-- Slavoj Zizek

Or, to slightly simplify: there is no such thing as "without political ideology". What you perceive as such is just a reflection of your own political ideology nonsense.
children.textZhHtml:
我已经一直在吃垃圾桶里的东西了。这个垃圾桶的名字是意识形态。

意识形态的物质力量让我看不到我实际上在吃什么。奴役我们的不仅仅是我们的现实。当我们处于意识形态之中时，我们的困境的悲剧在于，当我们认为我们可以通过梦想来逃避它时， 那时 我们处于意识形态之中。

——斯拉沃热·齐泽克

或者，稍微简单一点：不存在“没有政治意识形态”这样的事情。你所认为的只是你自己政治意识形态的胡言乱语的反映。
